purpose: Continuously reconcile stale institutional documentation, close evidence-backed gaps, add continuity-preserving internal links, rebuild recovered Help Center articles, and emit Phase 3 machine-seed deltas without fabricating authority or erasing history.

article_estate.rule: Every recovered title resolves to substantive canonical article, merged successor, redirect, restricted record, superseded-history record, or explicit unresolved-source record.
article_estate.count_scope: recovered legacy Help Center title estate; not equal to current Mintlify page count

phase_impact.reserved_rule: Do not invent names or gates for phases 11-20. Record impacts and unresolved definition requirements until authoritative phase definitions are adopted.

authority.d0: mechanical metadata, links, formatting, deterministic reconciliation
authority.d1: evidence-backed factual updates within established authority
authority.d2: material architecture, policy, rights, security, economic or phase-impact review required
